messages:
Maya (CSM): quick weekly on Acme — saw a notable model shift since yesterday's rollout, want to check health: usage, latency, fallback, cost trends. any red flags? :eyes:
Samir (SRE): pulling charts now. short summary: new-model-v3 uptake ~48% of traffic in 12h, fallback rate to v2 is 6.8% (was ~1.9% pre-rollout), p95 latency for v3 is 420ms vs v2 280ms, error rate (5xx) up from 0.2% to 1.1%.
Ethan (PM): thanks. is the fallback policy causing extra cost? also curious if it's user-visible quality or server-side errors.
Samir (SRE): cost per 1k requests for v3 ~+$0.45 due to longer decode time + more tokens; fallback churn accounts for ~10% extra calls (because we retry on non-empty error).
Lina (Support): we saw 3 customer tickets mentioning slower responses, one reported incomplete responses that later came back on fallback. cc @Maya
Maya (CSM): rough renewal risk? Acme is on a growth plan, they care latency. if numbers hold we should propose partial rollout or canary tweaks.
Ethan (PM): agree. propose throttling v3 to 25% and enable aggressive KV prefix caching for that account. would like SRE to estimate impact.
Samir (SRE): quick sim: lowering to 25% would cut v3 P95 surface by ~30% and reduce fallback churn to ~2.5%. enabling prefix cache cuts tokens ~12% on Acme queries (sampled). combined looks safe.
deploy-bot: rollout event: v3 -> acme-prod, percentage=50, started by ethan at 2025-07-10T10:02Z
Maya (CSM): can we do a 25% canary today and monitor 4 hours, then reassess? I'll flag proactive comms to the account.
Samir (SRE): can do. I'll schedule rollout change and add alert thresholds: fallback rate >3% OR v3 p95 >350ms triggers auto-scale + rollback window.
Ethan (PM): adding an eval set to check hallucination/fidelity on v3 vs v2. want to ensure quality isn't the root cause.
Lina (Support): I'll prepare a short customer note template — proactive heads-up + offer session to walk through changes.
Maya (CSM): action items: Samir -> implement 25% canary + alerts, Ethan -> run eval and share diff deck, Lina -> customer note draft, me -> sync with account exec on renewal messaging. check back in 4h. :thumbsup:
Samir (SRE): starting canary now. will post a short status update in this thread after 1h.
Maya (CSM): thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
